key_idea: Use a conformal map from the unit disk to a planar lens to construct a probability distribution on boundary coordinates, transforming the volume product lower bound into an exact real simplex identity.
reason: This proof is a masterpiece of cross-field unification, using 2D complex analysis and probability to cleanly and profoundly resolve a notoriously difficult problem in high-dimensional convex geometry. The logical structure is flawlessly straightforward and conceptual, culminating in a beautiful exact equality case via metric medians and the Hansen-Lima theorem.
